newsitem.title: UK: June ex-Soviet oil exports fall to 2.47 mbpd-IEA.
newsitem.headline: June ex-Soviet oil exports fall to 2.47 mbpd-IEA.

text.p: Exports of crude and refined products from the territories of the former Soviet Union declined by 400,000 barrels per day to 2.47 million bpd in June, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Tuesday.

It said the shortfall was mainly the result of lost capacity at Novorossiisk in the Black Sea due to an oil spill in late May/early June and weather-related closures. Black Sea exports fell to 0.89 mbpd in June from 1.29 mbpd in May.
In addition exports through the Druzhba Pipeline decreased by 16 percent because of maintenance in the Polish section, the Paris-based agency said in its latest market report.
The pipeline exported 730,000 bpd, down from 870,000 bpd in May.
Total seaborne exports in June were down by 204,000 bpd from May, to 1.80 mbpd, of which 630,000 bpd was products, down from 660,000 bpd in May.
Net April exports were 2.73 mbpd and March 2.74 mbpd, according to previous IEA reports.
